title: Bangladesh Rice Variety Register: officially approved rice varieties, with improved fish strains
description:
A register of every rice variety officially approved in Bangladesh, from the first meeting of the National Seed Board in 1974 to its 115th meeting on 5 February 2026, with the varieties recommended before the Board existed: identifiers, names in English and Bangla, developer, approval route and Board decision, gazette notification, pedigree, traits, documented CGIAR link, legal status in 2026 and quality flags. Every value is traced to a page of an archived source document, and every competing value is kept.

Companion tables cover the Board's decisions, official variety lists, improved fish strains and government acts on fish, CGIAR and literature sources, and a crosswalk to survey variety codes. Data and documentation are released under CC BY 4.0 and code under the MIT licence; third-party source documents keep their own rights (see NOTICE.md).
